summary: Complete testing of Return-Resubmit workflow for FX Trading Tracker. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified all features: returned badge, alert box with treasury remarks, Resubmit button, Upload Proof visibility rules. Fixed a minor frontend bug in TreasuryPage.jsx where process.env was undefined in some contexts.

fixed_bugs.issue: Runtime error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL') when viewing deal details with settlement proofs
fixed_bugs.fix: Changed direct process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL usage to module-level constant BACKEND_URL

passed_tests: Backend: Trader creates deal with proof of payment
Backend: Deal shows in Treasury queue as pending
Backend: Treasury returns deal with remarks
Backend: Trader sees returned deal with remarks
Backend: Trader can delete old proof on returned deal
Backend: Trader can upload new proof on returned deal
Backend: Resubmit changes status to pending and clears treasury fields (treasury_remarks='', processed_by=null, processed_at=null)
Backend: Resubmitted deal appears in Treasury queue
Backend: Treasury can confirm resubmitted deal
Backend: Audit trail logs 'deal_resubmitted' action
Backend: Resubmit returns 400 for pending deals (not returned)
Backend: Resubmit returns 400 for confirmed deals
Backend: Resubmit returns 400 for cancelled deals
Backend: Resubmit returns 403 for deals not owned by trader
Backend: Upload proof works for pending deals
Backend: Upload proof works for returned deals
Frontend: Trader sees deals with red 'returned' badge
Frontend: Returned deal detail shows red alert box with treasury remarks
Frontend: Resubmit button visible for returned deals
Frontend: Upload Proof button visible for returned deals
Frontend: Clicking Resubmit changes deal status to pending (success toast shown)
Frontend: Treasury Deal Queue shows pending deals correctly
Frontend: Treasury review dialog works with Confirm/Return buttons
Frontend: Upload Proof NOT visible for confirmed deals
Frontend: Upload Proof NOT visible for cancelled deals
seed_data_creation: Multiple test deals with TEST_ prefix created during backend testing for resubmit workflow verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: Return-Resubmit workflow fully tested. Key endpoints: PUT /api/deals/{id}/resubmit (trader only, only for returned deals, clears treasury_remarks/processed_by/processed_at). Audit action: deal_resubmitted. UI elements: resubmit-deal-btn, upload-proof-btn, returned-alert. Upload proof button only visible for pending/returned deals, not for confirmed/cancelled.

return_resubmit_workflow.details: Full cycle tested: Trader creates deal -> uploads proof -> Treasury returns with remarks -> Trader sees returned alert -> Trader uploads new proof -> Trader clicks Resubmit -> Status changes to pending -> Deal appears in Treasury queue -> Treasury confirms

resubmit_endpoint_validation.details: PUT /api/deals/{id}/resubmit - 400 for pending/confirmed/cancelled deals, 403 for non-owner, 200 only for returned deals owned by trader

upload_proof_visibility.details: Upload proof button only visible for pending and returned deals, not shown for confirmed or cancelled deals

audit_trail.details: deal_resubmitted action logged to audit trail with user details and deal reference

resubmit_endpoint.access: Trader only, must own the deal
